basics.description: **Keyring for Microsoft Sentinel** Deploys ASIM Audit Event parsers, scheduled analytic rule templates, hunting queries and the Keyring audit workbook for `KeyringAudit_CL` (and optional Azure Key Vault diagnostic log correlation). **Underlying Microsoft Services used:** This solution takes a dependency on the following services, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs: - Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled - Custom table `KeyringAudit_CL` created via `infra/modules/audit-sink.bicep` - Azure Key Vault diagnostic settings (`AzureDiagnostics` or `AZKVAuditLogs`) for cross-log correlation rules For more details, see [docs/sentinel.md](https://github.com/jusso-dev/keyring/blob/main/docs/sentinel.md).

basics.name: getLAWorkspace
basics.toolTip: Lists Log Analytics workspaces in the selected subscription so they can be filtered to the chosen resource group.

basics.name: workspace
basics.label: Workspace
basics.toolTip: Select the Microsoft Sentinel workspace in this resource group.

constraints.allowedValues: [map(filter(basics('getLAWorkspace').value, (filter) => contains(toLower(filter.id), toLower(concat('/resourcegroups/', resourceGroup().name, '/')))), (item) => parse(concat('{"label":"', item.name, '","value":"', item.name, '"}')))]

options.text: This solution installs two ASIM Audit Event (1.0.0) workspace parsers for KeyringAudit_CL: vimAuditEventKeyring (filtering parser) and ASimAuditEventKeyring (parameter-less parser).
This solution installs the Keyring audit workbook covering secret reveals, top people and vaults, denied and refused events, audit sink health and per-person drill-down.

elements.name: workbook1-name
elements.label: Display name
elements.toolTip: Display name for the Keyring audit workbook.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid workbook display name.

options.text: This solution installs eight scheduled analytic rule templates (many secret reveals, reveal from a new address, denied probing across vaults, sensitive action outside working hours, forged or cross-site requests, secret shares, audit gap and unmatched SecretGet). Templates are not enabled automatically; configure and enable them from Analytics > Rule templates after installation.

This solution installs six hunting queries covering secret values read, private keys downloaded, deletes/purges/recoveries, refused and denied events, one person's activity, and side-by-side Key Vault log correlation.
